normative_extracts.quote: When a component renders, React compares the returned tree with the previous render using element type and key to decide whether to update or remount DOM nodes.
Mutating live DOM nodes triggers style recalculation and layout invalidation; batching minimal mutations reduces browser pipeline work.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Computes a minimal DOM mutation batch by diffing lightweight JS element trees in O(n) heuristics before committing writes to the live DOM.

production_failures.symptom: Input focus and typed text jump to the wrong row when sorting or prepending a list
production_failures.root_cause: List items used array index as key={i}, causing reconciliation to reuse existing DOM nodes for different data items.
production_failures.mitigation: Assign stable, unique domain IDs as key={item.id} so reconciliation moves DOM nodes instead of mutating mismatched state.

production_failures.symptom: INP exceeds 300ms when typing in a filter box above a 1,000-row table
production_failures.root_cause: Top-level state update re-rendered and diffed 1,000 un-memoized VDOM subtrees synchronously on every keystroke.
production_failures.mitigation: Colocate input state, virtualize offscreen rows, or adopt fine-grained signals for O(1) leaf updates.
